usageNotes: Use this to poll real-time runtime state (CPU, memory, disk I/O, network counters, uptime, and PSI pressure metrics) for a specific LXC container on a remote PVE cluster. The remote must already be registered in PDM and the caller needs Resource.Audit on the remote/guest path. Omit the optional 'node' query parameter to let PDM locate the container automatically; supply it only when you know the exact node and want to enforce a placement assertion.

examples.summary: Get live status of LXC container 112 on remote 'pve-hetzner', auto-resolving the node

tips: cpu is a float ratio (0.0–1.0 × cpus), not a percentage — multiply by 100 to display as %.
disk I/O counters (diskread, diskwrite) reset to 0 on container restart; compare deltas between polls, not absolute values.
PSI pressure fields (pressurecpusome, pressureiosome, etc.) are only populated when cgroup v2 is active on the PVE host; they will be absent on older kernels.
A non-empty 'lock' field means the container is mid-operation (backup, migration, snapshot) — avoid issuing state-change calls while locked.
status will be 'stopped' for templates (template: true); runtime metrics like cpu/mem/uptime will be absent in that case.
